links.outcome: Expert-rated clinical accuracy and concordance with Chinese DDH guidelines of LLM responses
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 higher accuracy than ChatGPT-4o (4.70 vs 3.69, P<0.001) and higher guideline concordance (4.44 vs 3.82, P<0.001); ChatGPT-4o lower on both.
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1 had higher clinical accuracy than ChatGPT-4o across 31 caregiver-oriented questions (mean question-level score 4.70 [SD 0.15] vs. 3.69 [0.28]; P < 0.001) and higher guideline concordance across 22 items (4.44 [0.22] vs. 3.82 [0.33]; P < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1) on answering Chinese-language caregiver questions about developmental dysplasia of the hip, assessed by pediatric orthopaedic surgeons. It does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
